item.tib: sde brgyad srog dbang me dbal thog mda'
item.coloph: de ltar gsang ba bsngags kyis (sngags kyi) yang snying 'di/ yum gcig 'od ldan 'bar ma'i (mas/)dus mtha'i rnal 'byor dad ldan pa/ gnas mchog shel le rdzongs (rdzong) drug tu/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ dbal gshen yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ bka' skyongs srungs (srung) ma rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba (bas) 'gro kun bla med sa thob shog/
